## Checklist

- [ ] Lint, typecheck and build pass locally (`npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build`)
- [ ] Works with the keyboard; new controls have accessible names
- [ ] New or changed datasets have a citation, licence and source link (in `src/lib/datasets.ts` and the README)
- [ ] No keys, tokens or `.env` files are committed
